paragraphs: Chargerback runs cloud based lost and found software that businesses use to reunite people with things they left behind. The platform is reached from any mobile device.

Someone who lost an item files a report through a form on the site. Nothing has to be installed, training is free, and the company says the service costs the business nothing when items ship through Chargerback. The described technology covers image recognition, full data encryption, PII protection, touchless return and a full chain of custody. The software is presented as GDPR ready for the European Union. It is also described as CCPA compliant.
Chargerback says its partner base includes Fortune 100 and 500 companies. It describes itself as the only patent protected cloud-based lost and found software available.

quote.text: Whether you are Looking for Something Lost® or Looking for Something Found®, Chargerback™ is your resource.
